name: Thomas M. Melsheimer
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: Thomas M. Melsheimer, an attorney with King & Spalding LLP in Dallas, Texas, helps clients address Business Litigation situations. He also helps clients with Intellectual Property Litigation and Criminal Defense: White Collar concerns.
He received legal training from The University of Texas School of Law. He graduated from law school in 1986. Thomas Melsheimer became licensed to practice law in 1986.
Thomas Melsheimer was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026.
